name: Lago Norte

queries.query: Lago Norte Brazil official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry Brasília
queries.result: First-party discovery found SEDUH's official Geoportal page and the IDE-DF public ArcGIS REST MapServer, including the Lote Luos parcel polygon layer.

queries.query: Lago Norte Brasil cadastro predial mapa de lotes parcelas Geoportal oficial Brasília
queries.result: A pesquisa em português found SEDUH's public Geoportal, the official Portal Parcelamentos do Solo, and the IDE-DF service. The IDE-DF layer identifies RA-XVIII Lago Norte through its coded region field and returns bounded parcel geometry anonymously.

registryEvidence.custodian: Secretaria de Estado de Desenvolvimento Urbano e Habitação do Distrito Federal (SEDUH), through the official Geoportal and IDE-DF public map service.
registryEvidence.localScope: The service's LUOS layer contains coded RA-XVIII (Lago Norte) parcel records; this is local Distrito Federal urban-lot map evidence, not merely national-agency prose.

parcelDiscovery.source: IDE-DF Publico/IDEDF MapServer layer 138, Lote Luos
parcelDiscovery.crs: EPSG:31983 source; sample reprojected by server to EPSG:4326
parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: where=lu_ra_luos=18, outFields=objectid,lu_cod_par, returnGeometry=true, resultRecordCount=3, orderByFields=objectid ASC

fieldMapping.nativeIdentity: objectid (ArcGIS OID; retained as GeoJSON properties.id string)

parcelDiscovery.note: The exact WUP point query returned zero intersecting features. This is recorded as a point-level miss only; the RA-XVIII bounded query established city/administrative-area parcel coverage and supplied three retained polygons. No coordinate was shifted.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200 via first-party discovery; page states the GeoPortal is public and provides exact lot location and urban/cartographic information.
HTTP 200; public ArcGIS REST service metadata identifies CADASTRO_TERRITORIAL and LUOS groups, supported JSON/GeoJSON queries, and service CRS EPSG:31983.

HTTP 200; Lote Luos polygon layer metadata exposed native objectid OID, lu_cod_par, lu_ra_luos, shape, and EPSG:31983. Unsafe owner/address/titleholder/tax/account fields were not requested or retained.
HTTP 200; zero features at the exact transformed WUP point. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

HTTP 200; bounded anonymous GeoJSON response returned three full polygons with native objectids 7, 8, and 16. The response indicated exceededTransferLimit because additional RA-XVIII records exist; only three were retained.

uncertainty: The Lote Luos layer is an urban land-use/lot layer and may not equal the complete legal cadastral fabric or registry title dataset.
The exact WUP point fell outside a returned polygon; the point was not moved and the miss was not generalized.
The sample is limited to three records from a bounded RA-XVIII query; it is not citywide completeness evidence.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception were used.
